sources.title: SWIN-MTL: Swin Transformer based Multi-Task Learning Model
sources.snippet: SWIN-MTL: Swin Transformer based Multi-Task Learning Model Introduction This repository provides a Python-based implementation of an efficient Multi-task learning architecture for dense prediction tasks. The repository is based upon Swin-Transformer and uses some modules from Multi-Task-Learning-PyTorch.

sources.title: GitHub - lxq1000/SwinFace: Official Pytorch Implementation of the paper ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents a multi-purpose algorithm for simultaneous face recognition, facial expression recognition, age estimation, and face attribute estimation (40 attributes including gender) based on a single Swin Transformer. Our design, the SwinFace, consists of a single shared backbone together with a subnet for each set of related tasks.
